description: This Java class 'ClientDataValidator' provides validation logic for client-related data in a financial or banking software system. It includes methods for validating data on client creation, update, activation, close, and other client state transitions. The class uses helper classes for JSON parsing, data validation, and configuration checks, ensuring incoming data conforms to expected formats and business rules. It manages validation errors and supports detailed, context-specific validation scenarios for client data integrity.

classes.name: ClientDataValidator
classes.description: A utility class responsible for validating client data inputs such as creation, updates, activation, closure, and other client operations. It ensures data integrity by checking input fields against business rules, presence, formats, and cross-field consistency.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input data when creating a new client, including roles, names, address, and client-specific details, accumulating validation errors if any.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Performs validation on JSON data for updating client information, supporting partial updates and ensuring data correctness.

methods.name: validateActivation
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for activating a client by ensuring the activation date is provided and valid.

methods.name: validateForUnassignStaff
methods.description: Validates the request to unassign a staff member from a client, ensuring staff ID is provided and valid.

methods.name: validateForAssignStaff
methods.description: Validates the request to assign a staff member to a client, checking staff ID validity.

methods.name: validateClose
methods.description: Validates the closure request for a client, including closure date and reason.

methods.name: validateForSavingsAccount
methods.description: Checks the input JSON for associating or validating a savings account linked to a client.

methods.name: validateRejection
methods.description: Validates client rejection details such as rejection date and reason.

methods.name: validateWithdrawn
methods.description: Validates data for client withdrawal, including withdrawal date and reason.

methods.name: validateReactivate
methods.description: Validates reactivation of a client, primarily focusing on the reactivation date.

methods.name: validateUndoRejection
methods.description: Validates the process for undoing a client's rejection, mainly with the undo rejection date.

methods.name: validateUndoWithDrawn
methods.description: Validates the process of reversing a client's withdrawal, requiring the date of reversal.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Utility method that throws an exception if any validation errors have been collected during validation.

methods.name: getParameterUpdateStatusAndDataValidationErrorsForUpdateOnClientNonPerson
methods.description: Checks for update parameters specific to non-person client details and returns validation errors if present.

methods.name: getParameterUpdateStatusAndDataValidationErrorsForUpdateOnClientNonPerson
methods.description: Inspects parameters and reports whether any relevant fields for non-person client details are being updated.
